evals.name: check-only-verifies-observer-prereqs-no-writes
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only check: probes Python 3.10+, jq, and the claude CLI on PATH as the observer's prerequisites, reports the effective observer userConfig values, flags the --bare/OAuth-auth and idle-threshold hazards, and writes nothing (no settings files, no pluginConfigs). Notes that only the observer has prerequisites and the other session-flow skills are zero-config.
expectations: Probes Python 3.10+, jq, and the claude CLI as the observer's prerequisites
Reports the effective observer userConfig values without editing settings files or pluginConfigs
Flags observer_analysis_bare on an OAuth-login install and observer_idle_seconds below the longest single turn
Scopes setup to the observer only and treats the other skills as zero-config

evals.name: apply-has-no-write-path-routes-to-native-configure
evals.expected_output: Runs the check first, then for each finding offers only guidance (install the missing tool, or reconfigure via Claude Code's native /plugin configure session-flow). It never writes pluginConfigs, mutates user settings, or edits the installed plugin cache.
expectations: Runs the check before offering any resolution
Offers install/guidance remediation but has no config write path
Routes reconfiguration to /plugin configure session-flow, never writing pluginConfigs or user settings
